_comment: Copy-ready shape for one row of shared/scripts/vendor-census.py's output. Delete this _comment key before use, JSON has no native comment syntax.
category: <one of: analytics | tag-manager | chat | payments | cro-testing | seo-injection | ads | consent-cmp | other>
